description: Prospective-evaluation registry. The champion is frozen: its source file hash is verified before every fit and by the prediction service. Challengers are pre-registered here before they record any prospective forecast; adding or changing one requires a commit, so the registration date is auditable in git.

champion.fit: refit on every scheduled run on all results available before the run time (OpenFootball 2019-20..2025-26 + current-season Wikipedia results)

challengers.definition: Stage 3 Elo (initial 1500, K 20, home advantage 50, date-batched) -> ordered logit (ridge 0.001) on elo_diff, trained on every historical match after the first 380 (Elo burn-in) using its own pre-match Elo as of 00:00 UTC on match day. Identical to the Stage 9 candidate 'elo_ordered_logit'.
challengers.reason: component of dc_elo_equal_average; needed to interpret it

challengers.definition: 0.5 * champion probabilities + 0.5 * elo_ordered_logit probabilities. Identical to the Stage 9 candidate 'dc_elo_equal_average'.
challengers.reason: only Stage 9 challenger whose holdout CI included an improvement: log-loss diff -0.0030 [-0.0108, +0.0048] on 380 matches (inconclusive)

promotion_rule.criteria: paired ISO-week block bootstrap (2000 samples): challenger-minus-champion log-loss CI95 upper bound < 0 AND Brier difference <= 0, on settled prospective fixtures only
promotion_rule.note: Meeting the rule makes a challenger eligible for human review. The registry is never changed automatically.
